mapper.select: select a.name label, a.id value, if(l.id, '已绑定', '') extra from iot_event_source a left join iot_linkage l on a.id=l.event_source_id

select a.*, esd.event_source_id ma_event_source_id, ma.id ma_id, ma.type ma_type, ma.code ma_code, ma.direct ma_direct, ma.product_id ma_product_id , ma.name ma_name, ma.status ma_status, ma.func_type ma_func_type, ma.trigger_mode ma_trigger_mode from iot_event_source a left join iot_event_source_detail esd on a.id= esd.event_source_id left join iot_model_api ma on ma.id = esd.model_api_id and ma.func_type='read' and ma.trigger_mode='passive' where a.id=#{id}
select pdg.* from iot_event_source a inner join iot_device_group dg on dg.id=a.device_group_id inner join iot_device_group pdg on pdg.group_product_id=dg.group_product_id where a.id=#{id}

select p.* from iot_event_source a inner join iot_device_group dg on a.device_group_id = dg.id left join iot_device_group pdg on pdg.id = dg.group_product_id left join iot_product p on json_contains(pdg.product_ids, concat('', p.id)) where a.id=#{id} and p.status = #{status}
